time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Time of literature publication. Measurements took place partly before this period.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Assumption for production in Morocco based mainly on data from Florida. Some data from Moroccan mines. Various processes with location RER used.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
U.S. technology for dry rock or dried wet rock processing. Average technology mix modelled. No specific age of technology modelled

# Included processes
Mining process, transport to beneficiation plant, dry processing including crushing, screening or washing and flotation.Drying orcalcination of washed rock included. Land use for mining and reclamation.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data for emissions and land use based on various studies from Florida. Energy data based on a world-wide survey and some assumptions. Further data from Moroccan studies, literature and estimations.
